columns.name: country
columns.description: Unique identifier for the country, which is the country name

columns.name: number_of_tweets
columns.description: The number of tweets posted by the users in the country, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: percentage_of_male_users
columns.description: The percentage of male Twitter users from the country.

columns.name: number_of_likes
columns.description: The number of likes on tweets from the country, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: number_of_positive_sentiment_tweets
columns.description: The number of tweets with positive sentiment from the country, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: tweets_with_most_number_of_likes_sent_by_male_users
columns.description: The tweet text sent by a male user in the country with the highest number of likes, with ties broken by the ascending order of tweet ID
